persona: Procurement executive and SAP MM key user moving into consulting
resumeText:
Priya Venkataraman | Bengaluru | priya.venkat@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Procurement Executive and SAP MM Key User, Nandi Auto Components, Bengaluru (2019 - present)
- Created purchase orders, scheduling agreements and stock transport orders in SAP MM daily.
- Mapped the as-is purchase approval process with BPMN flowcharts for the S/4HANA project.
- Wrote 60 UAT test cases for purchasing and goods receipt and signed off the test cycle.
- Gathered requirements from plant buyers for the new PO release strategy.
- Trained 25 buyers and stores staff on MIGO and MIRO after go-live.
- Coordinated with finance, the SAP partner team and suppliers during cutover.

Purchase Assistant, Kaveri Castings, Mysuru (2017 - 2019)
- Maintained vendor price records in Excel and followed up on open orders.

SKILLS
SAP MM, MIGO, MIRO, Excel, BPMN

EDUCATION
BCom, Bangalore University, 2017
MBA Operations, Christ University, 2019
